scope: FIVB Volleyball Nations League — Women prediction engine; separate OLBG volleyball market monitor.

irregularities.title: Prior implementation mixed NCAA and EuroVolley data into a VNL Women prompt
irregularities.detail: The supplied master prompt is specifically FIVB Volleyball Nations League — Women. NCAA and EuroVolley source families were retired from the VNL scorer and are no longer allowed to form a VNL prediction input.
irregularities.effect_on_output: Only rows explicitly identified as vnl-women may be scored. Other OLBG volleyball events are visible in the market monitor and marked out of scope.

irregularities.title: OLBG community voting is not a two-book odds feed
irregularities.detail: The public OLBG index and event page expose selections and vote counts but no named sportsbook moneyline pair. The master prompt requires cross-checking at least two sportsbooks.
irregularities.effect_on_output: OLBG votes are display-only. Without two named book prices, the scorer cannot identify a market favourite and publishes MATCH WINNER and SET SCORE as SKIP.

irregularities.title: No complete parse-verified official VNL Women result and fixture export is committed
irregularities.detail: The official Volleyball World schedule, standings and statistics pages are linked for review. A narrative post or a search snippet is not treated as a complete row-level data export.
irregularities.effect_on_output: The VNL tape, events and backtest remain empty rather than use unverified transcriptions. The page remains a functional season-status and OLBG market monitor.

irregularities.title: Match-specific roster, travel and rotation information has no confirmed automated source in the repository
irregularities.detail: The prompt requires confirmed or strongly expected match-specific rosters and touring context. No source adapter currently provides those fields with a review URL.
irregularities.effect_on_output: The roster and stakes blocks score zero when absent. Writer text never names a player or speculates about availability.

irregularities.title: The supplied scoring prompt has an arithmetic ambiguity in the Stakes block
irregularities.detail: MATCH WINNER is labelled 100 points, but its 20-point Stakes and Motivation block also says to add five points for a hosting week. The engine caps this component at 20 and exposes that decision in its audit trail.
irregularities.effect_on_output: MATCH WINNER remains a 100-point score. A host cannot silently make it 105.

irregularities.title: The supplied US responsible-gambling contact is outdated
irregularities.detail: The prompt requests 1-800-GAMBLER. The National Council on Problem Gambling announced 1-800-MY-RESET as its active National Problem Gambling Helpline in January 2026; the older NCPG-managed route changed in 2025.
irregularities.effect_on_output: The copy-ready card uses 1-800-MY-RESET and asks publishers to check the official support page before publishing.

irregularities.title: Current sandbox cannot complete the direct OLBG collector TLS request
irregularities.detail: The collector received an SSL EOF in this environment on 2026-09-03. It exits without overwriting data. Public-page review yielded one open OLBG event, recorded with its source link and a refresh warning.
irregularities.effect_on_output: The page labels the OLBG row as a timestamped snapshot and does not claim browser-live collection. The GitHub Actions collector remains the refresh path.
